capabilities: Publish marked notes to a GitHub repository via the GitHub API
Batch publish and delete notes based on the pub-blog frontmatter mark
Manage publish states with a visual Publication Center including diff view
Upload images to the repo and rewrite image links to a configured URL prefix
Map vault folder paths to different blog repo paths with rewrite rules
extras: README is written primarily in Chinese with a full English section included; publishing requires the user to already have a blog repo with a deployment workflow such as GitHub Actions.
intentEvidence: 基于 Obsidian Digital Garden 修改。
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to a self-hosted GitHub-based blog, forcing users to copy and reformat files manually.
